description.value: A busy lakeside park 12 km north of Quesnel on paved Highway 97, offering three sandy beaches, flush toilets, showers, and rainbow trout fishing; campground gates close off-season so access is summer only.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Lakeside Campground' but the linked website is BC Parks' Ten Mile Lake Park page; 'Lakeside Campground' is likely the name of the specific campground within the park, operated by Silvertip Park Services Ltd. The website confirms showers in the highlights section and a picnic shelter referenced in the trail description, and a 'Book camping' link with frontcountry reservation policies confirms reservations are accepted. OSM tags supply capacity (60), no internet access, and a sanitary dump station; cycling is explicitly addressed on the website though the e-biking passage was cut off before key details.
